cells.gaps: The two rows held (DZA-008, DZA-009) are governance only: a first team of 20 trained on DHIS2 in December 2023 and a digital health strategy still in draft in November 2023. Nothing says which tiers report through it, where data is keyed or how many primary clinics enter their own reports; finance is not stated, and there is no dated statement that reporting has no digital entry.
cells.note: Restaged 2026-10-09 on the amended rung 2 (Bill): staff trained on a named platform by the ministry in December 2023, inside the 36 months, is preparation, which is stage 2 without use. No tier, district or clinic is shown using it, so nothing above 2. Was unplaced.

cells.gaps: No count or share of hospitals or primary clinics using the record has been found. The national deployment plan launched in July 2026 (DZA-016) aims at over 2,500 structures in 69 wilayas, and El Watan (DZA-020, 7 September 2026) has the record under way in several pilot facilities with a 15 November 2026 deadline for all public establishments; the El Moudjahid editorial (DZA-007) says generalisation in hospitals is being finalised, with no count. The value shared rests on a ministerial statement of February 2024 (DZA-010) that does not say where the record is keyed. DZA-004 and DZA-005 are from the excluded source and set nothing.
cells.note: The record is in pilot facilities and ten pilot wilayas, with national roll-out planned and funded but not done: stage 2. Stage 3 needs most T1 and T2 hospitals or primary clinics in some districts using it, and no count shows that.
